name: Aggregate Holding Balance 1
definition: Overall holding position, in a single financial instrument, held in a securities account at a specified place of safekeeping.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Identification of the financial instrument for which the balance information is specified.

HoldingForm.name: Holding Form
HoldingForm.definition: Form of ownership of the holding.

HoldingPhysicalType.name: Holding Physical Type
HoldingPhysicalType.definition: Specifies whether the holding is physically delivered or is a book entry only.

BalanceForFinancialInstrument.name: Balance For Financial Instrument
BalanceForFinancialInstrument.definition: Balance breakdown on the net position of the financial instrument.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
